'''Liqui-stasis tanks''' were devices used aboard the [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport|''Mantaris''-class amphibious transports]]. They were designed to preserve living creatures and [[Plant/Legends|plants]] in a state of suspended animation while those organisms were transported aboard the ''Mantaris'' ship's cargo haul.
